mechanism.observed: requested_internal_provider is rejected only when its normalized string belongs to a finite denylist of known external providers; unknown provider names pass while RouteDecision reports external_provider_dependency=false
mechanism.risk: an external or future provider can be misclassified as an internal provider-independent cognition path merely because its name is absent from the denylist
mechanism.required_invariant: internal cognition admission must use positive capability/class identity; UNKNOWN or EXTERNAL must fail closed before internal-cognition admission

falsifier_matrix: typo/case/whitespace variants -> REJECT unless resolved to an explicitly admitted local identity
provider absent -> ALLOW only when a positive local/internal engine identity is otherwise bound
